{{Quote|A radio? Well, I suppose talking to the Empire beats talking to the hasty walls.|Tripp D'jek, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DR" />}}
'''Tripp D'jek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Alliance Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I was part of a rescue team of 5 dropped in before the walls went up. We lost a squad of scouts...never did find them. Anyway, we were on foot at the last known location when they attacked.|Tripp D'jek, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RSC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Rebel Scout Camera|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tripp D'jek was a [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel trooper]] in the [[Alliance Army/Legends|army]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:RSC" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|accident]] took place in an [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] that was studied there escaped containment and decimated most of the people in the area, turning them into starving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. In response, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] promptly established a [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] to contain the infection. The few people who survived the initial virus outbreak were trapped in the Quarantine Zone. The survivors established camps in order to to repel the regular assaults of the zombies and try to live in safety while waiting for an evacuation.<ref name="SWG:MMR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Mysterious Meeting Request|Dathomir}}</ref>

[[File:Camp_Gamma_Dathomir.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Camp Gamma]] in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].]]

The Rebel Alliance quickly discovered the accident on Dathomir and dispatched a small unit of Rebel troops, including Tripp D'jek, to investigate the Imperial Research and Prison Facility and rescue survivors. However, the Rebel forces were soon attacked by undead stormtroopers and suffered heavy casualties. When some Rebel soldiers started to display symptoms of the sickness, the evacuation missions were aborted and the few remaining Rebels were stuck in the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:RSC" /> Tripp D'jek eventually took shelter in [[Camp Gamma]],<ref name="SWG:DR" /> along with the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Kyra 'Naa]]<ref name="SWG:FWGC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Forward Watch, Gamma Camp}}</ref> and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Oona Wran]].<ref name="SWG:DCACG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Destroy Canisters Around Camp Gamma|Dathomir}}</ref>

Later, a spacer arrived at Camp Gamma and delivered a [[Radionics|radio]] to Tripp D'jek. The radio was provided by the [[TIE pilot|Imperial pilot]] [[Jeb Maris]] in [[Camp Alpha]] who had decided to establish communications between the camps. Once radios were delivered to the five camps in the Quarantine Zone, the survivors were able to safely coordinate high altitude supply drops sent from outside the Quarantine Zone.<ref name="SWG:DR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tripp D'jek was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tripp D'jek was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," a.k.a. the [[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|"Death Troopers" update]], released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>
